c0.instructions:
Does this review comment correctly identify a merge-blocking defect introduced by the supplied pull request diff?
COMMENT: The expr filter is applied before template interpolation. If a target has a non-empty expr that interpolates to an empty string, it will still be included and later executed, causing potential parse/backend errors. Filter should be applied after applyTemplateVariables instead.

c1.instructions:
Does this review comment correctly identify a merge-blocking defect introduced by the supplied pull request diff?
COMMENT: runSplitQuery now applies applyTemplateVariables unconditionally, but in the shard-splitting flow targets may already have had applyTemplateVariables applied once, resulting in multiple passes per request. This causes extra work and can re-apply ad hoc filters (like pipeline label-filters that are not de-duplicated), growing the query string across shard iterations. Consider adding an option to skip interpolation when callers already provided interpolated targets, or ensure this is only applied once per end-user query.
